svg.title: 2 tower power box wiring
svg.desc: 2 tower power box: mains, S-100-5, one 74AHCT125 (gate 1 joined to the 4 JST-SM strands), top-feed XT60, and gate 2 + an XT60 into the tip-tower cable. Generated by tools/wiring_diagrams.py; do not edit.
svg.text: 2 tower power box — in T2 and T6 of each statue, 4 to build
Mains in. One 74AHCT125, 2 gates used: gate 1 → its own tower's 4 JST-SM (one per face), gate 2 → the tip tower
next door (in T2: T1 · in T6: T7) through the tip-tower cable, which also carries its power from a second XT60.
the data cable from the master/slave box
one wire per face from this point
the tip tower's own data cable from the
master/slave box (in T2: T1 · in T6: T7)
22 AWG pair (DATA + GND), part of the tip-tower cable
XT60 out · top feed, own tower
at the top → 4 × XT60 to the strand tops
in T2: to T1 · in T6: to T7
What goes into one 2 tower power box
C14 inlet with switch and fuse
74AHCT125 in a DIP socket (2 gates used)
JST-SM in: own tower data + tip tower data
JST-SM out: faces 1–4, all from gate 1
XT60 out: top feed + tip-tower cable
data out for the tip-tower cable's 22 AWG pair (gate 2)
All flags with the same label are the same wire. The data inputs' 5V pins stay
unconnected so two supplies never join on +5 V. 100 Ω resistors optional.
Unused gates: input to GND, output open. No electronics anywhere in a tower:
the tip tower's 4 faces are joined at the far end of the tip-tower cable
(tip-tower-cable.svg), the same way gate 1 is joined to the 4 faces here.
